messages:
maya (support): quick heads-up — customer lina says she applied promo TRIAL100 via the support console but the credits never landed in the ledger. console shows success toast but no ledger entry. action id `0xabc123`

lina (customer): i clicked apply and i still have 0 credits :(

maya (support): repro steps i followed: 1) open support console -> customer -> credits tab 2) paste promo TRIAL100 -> confirm 3) toast 'Success' shows immediately 4) check /v1/admin/ledger?customer_id=... -> no new rows. backoffice returned 200 for action `0xabc123`.

backoffice-bot: action 0xabc123 recorded: status=ACK response=200 payload={"amount":100,"reason":"promo:TRIAL100"} ledger_sync_job=enqueued

maya (support): attaching the small snippet from backoffice logs i pulled:```
2026-02-20T14:12:03Z INFO Received grant request action=0xabc123 customer=usr_987
2026-02-20T14:12:03Z INFO Returning 200 (async ack) action=0xabc123
2026-02-20T14:12:04Z ERROR ledger-sync action=0xabc123 error=UniqueConstraintViolation on credits(id)
2026-02-20T14:12:04Z WARN tombstone_written action=0xabc123
2026-02-20T14:12:05Z INFO retry queued ledger-sync action=0xabc123
```

jonah (eng): thanks @maya — can you DM me the full customer id and the raw admin payload? initial read: service is returning success before ledger write completes (async ack). the UniqueConstraintViolation suggests a race on the ledger write, and we may be leaving a tombstone flag that prevents replays from creating a final ledger row.

maya (support): sent you DM with customer usr_987 and full payload.

jonah (eng): quick mitigation: ops can reprocess the action: `reprocess_ledger_action --id 0xabc123` — that will replay the tombstoned action and should create the ledger row if idempotency token not conflicting. long term: change admin console to treat async ack as pending for promo grants and suppress toast until ledger ack or a timeout. also add stronger idempotency checking and clearer tombstone handling.

karen (ops): running reprocess now. output: `reprocess_ledger_action --id 0xabc123 -> ok, ledger row created id=led_555, customer=usr_987, amount=100` :thumbsup: i'll monitor for duplicates and check for any stray tombstones.

maya (support): customer updated — credits reflected now. i offered a sincere apology and an extra 50 credits as a gesture; customer accepted.

jonah (eng): i opened GH issue #INF-842 add: 1) UI waiting for ledger ack on promo grants (5s poll, then fallback) 2) improve tombstone replay path 3) add alert if tombstone_count > 0 for promo grants. assigning to eng-runtime and ops.

karen (ops): noted. i'll add a short runbook step to reprocess tombstones and include exact CLI commands.

maya (support): can we avoid toasting success on async ack in next patch? that will reduce customer confusion.

jonah (eng): agreed — patch planned for next sprint. i'll post the PR link when ready. thanks everyone. :eyes:
